g.text: TDP43–HK1 | inspect the actual proposed cavity traces
100-unit all-object reconstruction. Orange = cavity trace; blue circle = adjacent orientation cue, where identifiable. No original microscopy pixels were available.
Cavity and cue are computational visual proposals, not confirmed homologous anatomy. They do not change the scientist review file.
